name: GNAS complex locus

function.text: GNAS encodes neuroendocrine secretory protein 55 [Cleaved into: LHAL tetrapeptide; GPIPIRRH peptide]. It participates in female pregnancy and protein secretion.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to progressive osseous heteroplasia (autosomal dominant); pseudohypoparathyroidism type 1A (autosomal dominant). Postzygotic mosaic associations are recorded separately.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Appendiceal adenocarcinoma; Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma; Juvenile granulosa cell tumor of ovary. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from G2P. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
